# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — NOT a device capture. Hand-written to hold the account
# shape the two real captures do not: SR Linux LIST users, the accounts an
# operator adds (`user <name>`), beside the two built-in ones. No credential
# here belongs to any device; every value is a placeholder.
set / system aaa authentication idle-timeout 7200
set / system aaa authentication authentication-method [ local ]
set / system aaa authentication admin-user password $y$PLACEHOLDERHASH
set / system aaa authentication admin-user ssh-key [ "ssh-ed25519 PLACEHOLDERPUBLICKEY" ]
set / system aaa authentication linuxadmin-user password $6$PLACEHOLDERHASH
set / system aaa authentication user noc-readonly password $y$PLACEHOLDERHASH
set / system aaa authentication user field-tech password PlaintextPlaceholder1
set / system aaa server-group local type local
set / system logging remote-server 10.0.0.10 transport udp
set / system ntp admin-state enable
set / system ntp server 10.0.0.20
